title: LLM Embark: Intake Translation, Stability Signing, and Anchored Release
creator: Asha Raman
description:
Build an end-to-end pipeline that takes community LLM weights through a deterministic translation layer, applies stability checks and provenance signing, and issues an anchored 'v1' release (version pin + performance profile) into the model catalog. This ticket focuses on the ingest adapter, format negotiation, lossless metadata wrapper, stability signer (cryptographic provenance + heuristic stability score), and the auto-anchoring rule that decides when a model may be published as v1. The goal is to reduce manual handoffs, provide repeatable conversion for quant-aware paths, and prevent flaky models from being pinned into production.

Scope:
- Weight intake adapter with manifest normalization and provenance capture.
- Translation harness supporting PyTorch, safetensors, and HF sharded formats to internal runtime bundle.
- Quantization-aware conversion hooks (FP16 -> int8 candidate paths) but conversion gated behind stability checks.
- Stability signer: combines deterministic smoke suite, suitability heuristics, and optional manual sign-off to emit a signed 'stability claim' artifact.
- Anchored release operator: evaluates stability claim + resource profile + perf pass to create model pin release and performance profile publication.

Out of scope: dataset-level safety evals (handled by safety team), canary rollout orchestration for production traffic (separate release ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Adapter correctly normalizes manifests from 5 sample community repositories and extracts provenance metadata fields (origin, checksum, commit, license)
Translation harness produces runtime bundle that passes deterministic smoke suite with identical tokenization/embedding outputs within 1e-6 tolerance across 3 runs
Stability signer computes a stability score and emits a signed artifact; score >= 0.8 required for auto-anchoring
Anchored release operator creates a pinned model entry and publishes a performance profile to the catalog UI and the perf dashboard
Automated tests and CI validate both conversion and signing with synthetic sharded inputs and quantized candidate paths

rollout_plan: Phase 1: Internal dogfood the pipeline using 3 non-production community models, verify stability signer and releases to the staging catalog (2 weeks). Phase 2: Add KMS-backed signing and SRE smoke canary for runtime bundles. Phase 3: Open Auto-Anchoring rule to select partners and measure false positive/negative rate for 30 days before enabling broad auto-pin. Manual sign-off option available throughout.
